reviews.text: Friendly vets that really care. Jose is excellent and very knowledgeable. Really trust them
Very professional and efficient service
All good and efficient.

My Bichon Frise Betsy needed a dental extraction. The team were considerate, prompt and so helpful. They did a fantastic job and were very upfront and reasonable with their costing. I highly recommend them.
I can find no fault whatsoever with Jose and the team at Abingdon who have been brilliant with my dog Lili when she was going through a difficult time. Caring and knowledgeable. Highly recommended.
Hi, Alasdair. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Very welcoming and my dog was treated very gently.
Super thoughtful and kind vêt.  Dog loves her!

Thank you for taking great care of my 18.5 year old Tom ❤️ he has kidney disease and we were very nervous about everything. We changed our vets because the previous vets did not care to do much for him given his age. Tom is now stable and his values have improved. The vets at Abingdon managed to get him to do an ultrasound without sedation which we really appreciated given he’s an old guy. I did not get the impression that the they were pushing for unecessary services like some other vets do, in fact they suggested cost effective options which we really appreciated.

Abdingon Vets always great. Vets very caring. Jose was amazing. He examined and vaccinated our new 8 week old kitten and we were so happy to see him again for check up and vaccines for our cat now 2 years old.

Best vet in the area! A lots of love from all employees there. Great services and prices.
Much appreciated!
I ASKED THE PRICES WHEN I VISITED FOR MY APPOINTMENT AND THE RECEPTIONIST ASKED ME IF I NEEDED A LISN TO HELP ???  CONSIDERING I LIVE IN A 3M APPARTMENT VERY WEIRD

Great vet and Jose and his staff are lovely. They are incredibly knowledgeable and trustworthy, and unlike many other vets they will not try and upsell you additional treatments etc.  Could not recommend more highly.
Very friendly caring staff! They make our little friends feel very comfortable.
Very friendly and great with pets.
Excellent bey, been using them for years, friendly, efficient
friendly, helpful
I was very thankful to this vet for helping my kitten come through the neutering process peacefully and successfully 🙏❤️
Amazing place for your vet and they are very professional and helpful and very nice to your pet ,always clean and happy place to be with your beloved animal 🐕🐶❤️🐱🐈🌄 …
Professionnal and right on time.
Practice really accommodating, take my cat to them all the time for monthly check ups
Everyone at this vet is lovely and caring of pets. Jose is the best! He is a cat whisperer, never seen my cat that calm as she gets her nails trimmed!

Hi Agetina, unfortunately we couldn't find any record of your visit under this name. 

Please do get in touch with us directly at the practice, as we would really appreciate the opportunity to speak with you personally and address your concerns.

Can’t express enough how grateful we are to Abingdon Vets. They carried out a very much needed dental extraction on our cat which has been extremely successful - not to mention that it was also half the price of an extortionate quote from Medivet.

The level of service was fantastic. Thank you again!

Avoid this clinic at all costs unless you have an unlimited budget. This is not a veterinary practice focused on animal care; it is a profit-driven business focused solely on aggressive upselling.

They have a disturbing pattern of skipping all reasonable, cost-effective treatment options. The moment my dog didn't show immediate results from basic anti-inflammatories, they bypassed any intermediate steps and pushed straight to an expensive specialist referral and a high-cost CT scan. It felt incredibly predatory, as if they were simply looking for the most expensive way to inflate my bill.

To make matters worse, their business model is designed to trap you. If you sign up for their subscription service, be warned: they use aggressive and hidden cancellation fees to ensure you can't leave easily. Between the astronomical medical costs and the predatory subscription tactics, this place is a total money-grab. Do yourself and your pet a favour.... go somewhere else.
Hi, Onizer. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Always a good experience! They are very professional and also very helpful.   Always trying to fit you in asap in case of emergency and I must say I haven’t been charged so much compare to other vet in the area .
100% recommended!

Excellent service needed an appointment quickly and got seen very quickly. Vet Jose very calm and informative and didnt rush the appointment. Left feeling reassured about my dogs symptoms and the course of medication.
Our mini labradoodle was looked after promptly and thoroughly with care and kindness on a Saturday no less!

I couldn’t be happier with the care Dumpling received when I brought him in to Abingdon for neutering. The whole team were professional, warm, and caring from start to finish.

Also I'd like to give a special thank you to student vet nurse Huma, who gave me brilliant advice and took such fabulous care of Dumpling. She was so kind, reassuring, and clearly made him feel safe. I think she may be Dumpling’s new best friend.
We love Abingdon! Very friendly staff, super kind to our pet. We are very thankful!
Hi, Words. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Highly recommend! Very fast and professional service. Thank you to the veterinary team—my cat is already feeling much better.
Very caring staff
Hi, Atomei. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Still best Vet in Kensington . Great reception team and Doctor Jose is always attentive and caring of my dogs !

Best Vet in Kensington 5***** Lovely place and team . The nurses and reception are v caring about my pets , and they have excellent doctors
I had all my dogs treated with them and they cared for my Shagane until the very last moments . I couldn’t thank them more . My other Maltese also had teeth extraction plus spaying at the same day and all went good , she recovered very quickly
Having had a traumatic experience with a ‘popular’ vet in the same area that seems to only care for ‘posh’ dogs  and left my little darling almost dying and just messed me about  , I found solace and hope plus all the necessary support at Abingdon Vet and will be forever grateful.

Great vets and also very good with my pup. What’s amazing is they ALWAYS pick up the phone which is what you want when you’re panicking over something! Unfortunately we have moved away but even till the end they’ve been so so helpful. Def recommend for anyone in the area

Amazing place. Incredibly professional and kind people ( nurses and staff). Excellent attention to detail and precise and tiny incision for a spay. Dr. Jose is wonderful with a beautiful bedside manner. Highly recommend. Thank you 🙏 …
very friendly, professional and effective

Always helpful and reliable vet service. Have been coming here for years for my cat, she was also spayed here and all went smoothly. Receptionists are also very helpful and knowledgeable. Helpfully it has links to emergency service in Elizabeth Street and vet ambulance too.
Wonderful staff!
Lovely little vet practice, friendly receptionists and vets who are competent and clearly love what they do.
Great outfit, lovely vets and nurses. Pay by phone parking on the side streets too!

First time visiting Abingdon Vet Clinic suggested by our regular vet, Elizabeth Street Vets. Jose was the vet Milo and I saw at Abingdon. Very knowledgeable about the AHC process and offered sound advice, went through all the legalities and processes of applying and adherence to rules. Thank you so much guys.
Lovely. They helped me clean up as cat had an accident on the way.
Great service!

What an amazing experience I had a this wonderful clinic. The kindness from the Vet Dr Jose, the amazing help and support with my Budgie travelling abroad, Huma and Harriet at the reception was beyond helpful, went the extra mile for support and advice. It's a very busy clinic but yet they are kind and helpful with a smile. What an amazing team they are , Dr Jose , Huma and Harriet thank you from the bottom of my heart for your kind way of being.
I love this fact they’re so friendly and understanding so much so that even though I’ve moved area temporarily, I’ll always go back to them in the end once I move back nearer.
Abingdon Veterinary Clinic are simply wonderful.  They truly care about the animals who need their help...and the owners too!!!  They have always been there for us.  I HIGHLY recommend  them!

I have been coming to this practice for a few years now. There is one particular staff member of abingdon vetinary clinic that I and many others adore, she is student vetinary nurse Huma 😁. She's kind, efficient and goes above and beyond, not just for me and my dog Derek, but for others too. She is the reason abingdon is the best clinic around. She's done so much for me ,which I the reason I would never leave this clinic.
Hi, Julia. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Professional Vet with efficient, reliable and friendly staff. Our dog needed surgery and Jose and his team did a brilliant job. Thank you.
Always a friendly and efficient service for my Chihuahua at Abingdon Vet!
Competent and friendly service. Both reception and the vets go out of their way to help rectify any issues in a timely manner.
Excellent assessment and very gentle with my 13yo poodle

My cat is usually extremely stressed at the vet’s office and quickly gets defensive, so I was extremely surprised to see how calm she was with Dr. Jose. Thank you very much for making her experience so good!
Always a good experience, excellent staff and reassuring with our nervous Chihuahua
It was our first time to the clinic and both the Vet and his staff were wonderful. The clinic is clean and tidy. My cat Challu was examined carefully and thoroughly. Our overall experience was great.
Hi, Todd. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Amazing veterinary with the best staff Jose & Huma.
Hi, Hakan. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

The best thing about Abingdon is the receptionist Huma she remembers everyone and their pets, she is always so friendly and pleased to see us and our Dog! If she left we would never return as they are expensive for the service

I’d like to give a special mention to Huma, the receptionist and student vet nurse here. She is always kind, cheerful, and welcoming, and has such a comforting presence, especially during the harder visits when things haven’t gone well with my pets. Her warmth and compassion make all the difference and truly set her apart. While the clinic itself in my experience is fairly disappointing (more about this is in another review), Huma makes every visit feel more caring and personal. She is an absolute credit to the team.

One of the best clinics I have ever been to! The staff is the loveliest and the most professional. Especially Huma she is absolutely the best, she goes above and beyond to help you. I’m truly so grateful for her.
Hi, Mo. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

Serious operation done by these fine folks on my gorgeous Westie after a dog attack. They were clear, professional, empathetic and the photos I saw of the procedure gave me so much confidence. The team are great fun and super lovely too!

Huma the student veterinary nurse was an Absolute delight! Zoe warmed to her immediately, and she was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. I had an amazing experience there (Zoe too) and will be looking forward to our next visit!
Excellent services specially by Dr. Cherisa Pua who was the attending Vet. Overall services by other staffs was very good too. Best Vet centre to sign up with.
We always have a great experience here. The team makes us feel comfortable and well cared for — and our cat does too!
Jose and the team are always outstanding. If I could give more stars, I would

We have been using this clinic since 1998, once upon a time it was run by a great vet called Ono and long serving friendly staff. The clinic was bought out a few years ago and steadily the service has got worse, we have a VIP monthly plan for our dog which is monthly payments to cover flea and worm treatments etc, my partner called the practice to  arrange to pick up the treatments to be told by Harriet that we owe them £217, for previous treatments despite the fact they’re included in our plan! Harriet emailed me an invoice for this, I was extremely confused so I called and explained we were on the plan and our dog had been registered with the clinic since she was born in 2018, Harriet said there was no record of us having this plan and our dogs notes only went back to 2021! As the direct debit goes from my partners account I had to call him to double check that we were still paying for this, which we indeed were the last payment had left the bank on 22nd July. I called back and explained this, at which point Harriet miraculously found the records! When I double checked the invoice that had been sent by her it said on it “VIP 6 month Health Check” as 1 of the listed items, to get this you would have to be on the VIP plan, yet Harriet couldn’t work that out? And decided to withhold the dogs medication and email out an invoice. It’s not acceptable and it’s appalling customer service to loyal customers that have used the clinic for the last 27 years.
The clinic has really gone down hill it’s not a pleasant place to go, it’s scruffy bordering on dirty, it was never  like that during Ono’s tenure. We have only stayed because of the VIP plan, I will say the plan itself is reasonably good value, and because there is 1 helpful friendly staff member a student vet nurse called Huma who is very kind and sweet with our dog , should there ever be anything seriously wrong with our dog, I think I would take her elsewhere, in fact we were recently advised during the VIP health check we were told our dog required entropian surgery, and we were sent an estimate of £1522, we took our dog for a 2nd opinion to a bulldog specialist vet who had previously operated on her cherry eye, who advised us against the procedure and told us to buy visco tears at £6 a tube use them twice a day which has completely cured the eye issue. I also checked the price of this minor surgery with other vets and found that it was considerably less expensive elsewhere.

My experience at the Abingdon Veterinary was very special. I took my cat to get her checked as she was not feeling well. I was welcomed by Huma at reception who was very kind friendly and caring towards my cat and very sympathetic with my worries, she tried to reassure me that my cat will be taken care of. My beautiful cat was then seen by the Vet José who was very thorough in his examination and treated my cat with care and great knowledge. I really recommend them as you feel that they are professionals and treat you with so much and kindness.
Thank you Huma and José for looking after my precious cat and being very caring and friendly.
Najwa Ayache

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic. Dr. Jose is very professional and caring, he treated my dog with great attention and explained everything clearly. Huma, the secretary, was extremely kind and helpful, she made the whole process smooth and welcoming. I truly appreciate both of them and highly recommend this clinic!
Extremely professional vets ! Thank you for taking such good care of our fluffy trio ! ❤️
Amazing vet! Kind, professional and truly caring. They took great care of my cat and made sure I felt informed and reassured throughout. You can tell they genuinely love animals. Highly recommended!

Had a pleasant visit at the vets, which is the norm here. The vet was informative, very friendly and the staff at the front desk were helpful and warm.

It's lovely here, though it may be a small practice, the care and attentiveness they show the animals and the owners is very BIG. Like one big family, thank you guys. Me & Bluebell(my kitty) love our check ins.
Hi, Mario. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Such an amazing veterinarian service. Highly recommended
The best veterinary in my experience, Dr Jose is very experienced and trustworthy and the stuffs are very lovely and helpful.
Super service and reassurance
Hi, Zeca. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

My sister introduced me to Abingdon as I was going to pets at home before, these are so much cheaper plus you get the VIP which is reasonable. I had appointment today for my puppy & the VIP covered everything apart from he's medication but you get discount & you also get free stuff. The staff was lovely & really made us feel at home💚 …

I absolutely love this clinic. I’ve been bringing my dog (Leo) here for four years, and the experience has always been outstanding. All the vets are incredibly kind and caring. We’re usually seen by José, who is an exceptional veterinarian, he always takes the time to answer my questions clearly and thoroughly.

Huma, the vet receptionist, is also fantastic! She’s warm, welcoming, and highly efficient, always handling everything with a smile. Her genuine kindness and care for the animals make every visit so much smoother. She’s truly an asset to the clinic!
Hi, Billie. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Our cats always come here - if they enjoy is another matter! On this particular occasion the right action was to direct us to their partner clinic for investigation. Hopefully all of our cats will have many more years looking forward to their check-ups and lovely chat with vet and staff at Abingdon's.
Really good first experience with Abingdon, receptionist was friendly and helpful and our Vet Jose demonstrated a lot of care and attention in dealing with my pet. Thank you!
Kind, pet centred, left feeling cared for.
Hi, Billie. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
As always the receptionist was friendly and welcoming and the vetinarian was very gentle with our little cat and gave excellent advice and care.
Professional efficient & friendly staff . Excellent Veterinary clinic.

This Vets is Fabulous!!.I managed to get an apt at such short notice for my Labrachon dog Cocoa!!.Huma was lovely on the phone.Big Shout out to Huma !!what a  huge star in the Sky!!.Shes amazing!!What a welcome!! and  taking time at end of day to chat with me too.So understanding.
Jose’ was great and helped me so much and calm my worries very quickly.He also joined us.Amazing vet!!
I left feeling relieved,reassured and happy I chose you!!,armed with food and syringe of Digest care
Love from Cocoa too!!.
See you again!!❤️
Hi, Elisa. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

I love this clinic. I have been taking my dog here for 6 years. All the vets are very kind and caring. Huma is a wonderful vet receptionist! She's always so welcoming and efficient, handling everything with a smile. Her kindness and genuine care for the animals make every visit much easier. She's a real asset to the clinic!

I love this vet clinic. I’ve been coming since I moved from Canada in 2023 and have had a great experience, including a tooth extraction for my pup. They’re very responsive and Huma Jose at the front desk is so friendly and makes bean and myself feel really comfortable before/after an appointment! Highly recommend for those looking for a new vet in the area
Hi, Andrei. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Amazing service and care with my Panda. Huma is so attentive and caring, thanks so much!
Friendly and efficient.

As usual, terrific service from Abingdon vets. They do however need urgently to improve their call waiting telephone response. Having to listen repeatedly to 60 seconds of their same self promotion shpiel, in this case for a total of 10 mins is enough to drive anyone crazy.

This is a clinic where I feel very comfortable. The staff are friendly and efficient, always willing to help.

Today, I was not attended by Clio’s vet, Dr. Serrano, who was also my previous pet’s vet two years ago. Now, with a new furry member in my family, I trust Dr. Serrano with Clio as well.

I MUST add to my positive and thankful comments a special mention of Ms. Huma—she is wonderful, wonderful, wonderful! She guided and helped me, without really knowing me, ensuring that I got Clio without missing a step when dealing with the process and collecting her.

Previously, she had advised me to adopt, but I was refused because I don’t live in the UK.
Today’s vet thorough and polite and was good. I still have to apply the treatment given to Clio but I believe is going to work well .

On hold on the phone for 10 mins. Arrived there 2 mins later and saw 3 members of staff chatting.
Every time have taken my pet there had to wait 10-15 mins to be seen.
They don’t seem to have a client oriented attitude.

I’ve been coming to Abingdon Vet since 2009 and although I was very sad when the previous owner vet left, I have been happy with the current vets so far. Every staff is friendly and professional, too.
I think the resident vet, Jose, is so knowledgeable. He got to the bottom of my dog’s illness and she is now stable with the right treatment and doing well.
I have moved a bit further from the practice now but I’m not changing the vet any time soon!
Always great service from the team. Jose is a great vet supported by a very knowledgeable, warm and friendly team.
Staff couldn’t be more friendly, caring and efficient. Warmly recommend this veterinary clinic ❤️

My experience with Abingdon Veterinary Clinic was fantastic! From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted my cat so warmly, making us feel right at home. They were incredibly welcoming, and every interaction from the friendly care to answering my concerns over the phone it  professional and kind. Highly recommend for loving, top-notch care!
1st visit today, for our puppy's vaccination. The veterinary has a very friendly team, with a genuine care and love for pets.

STAY AWAY !!!  Dreadful experience.  6 visits - 6 different random vets.  Injured my dog trying to take blood in 4 different veins.  Misdiagnosed my dog having heart trouble when he was just nervous given the rough handling.  I contacted the surgery many times to complain - no return email or return call.  They do not care.  STAY AWAY
Huma and Clyde are so kind a professional! They’ve taken such good care of us on extremely short notice and with so much patience

I am following up on my last review about poor behaviour of a member of the staff. I have received a very apologetic call from the lovely nurse Huma in the meantime. What a star employee and pleasure to speak to! The clinic should count themselves lucky to have her. She was empathetic and understanding and listed to me and helped to find a way  forward for my dog. Thank you, Huma! You are the best! We look forward to seeing you when we visit the clinic again!

I've been going to Abingdon for the last 2+ years with my elderly dog. They are always super helpful and supportive. The whole team at reception are especially kind and accommodating. They've made managing a tough few years that little bit easier. 🙏🏼 …
Hi, Marisela. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Just wanted to thank Huma for her kindness and support every time we visit the clinic!
She is always very helpful and cheerful, which makes the visit a very  pleasant one!!

Great first time visiting this Vet. He explained everything really well and seemed very knowledgeable. The 2 receptionists ladies (Karlae and Huma) are wonderful! Very helpful, sweet and chatty. They also carry Royal Canin and my dog loves that brand. I will definitely come back here. Thank you! :)
Amazing service lots of great people and helpful staff especially Huma who helped us get everything sorted also fun for the animals!
Hi, Maryam. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!

Went to the vet for our kitten’s first health check. Huma gave us a warming welcome and Ciaran is really professional and lovely to talk to. It’s our first cat, so they gave us a lot of information. The health plan they offer is really helpful as well. Just every thing you need for your baby to be healthy and happy.
Huma really helped us. She is very kind l I was very stressed about my kitten and she manage to help us a lot. So thank you
I have always had a good experience at this Vetinarian practice
Super caring vets and nursing staff, very reasonable fees. Small practise with very personal service.
Very helpful and caring staff. My dog was looked after well and I would recommend them to other pet oners.

Wonderful, generous, and potentially life saving experience with this vet today for my kitten.
A special thank you to Harriet 💐😇 …
